104: Piled on it - that these particular movable objects be resting on that particular land.

And for confession - this is not [included in the] proper reading, since even one who does not own any land can confess as to his tithes, and is able to say "and bless Your people Israel and the soil you have given us" (Deuteronomy 26:15). It is not similar to the first fruits [bikkurim] where one must [be able to truthfully] say "which You have given me" (Deuteronomy 26:10).
